title: Tooling: preserve full payloads in PR589 gzip rebuild comparisons
body:
The selected PR589 bit replay compares two regenerated gzip containers with `cmp`. Eight controlled recompressions of the actual base/tuned words fail those checks despite identical complete decompressed bytes. This opt-in adapter replaces only those two comparisons and their success message; frozen sources, exact input hashes, all mathematical commands, and the default selected entrypoint remain unchanged.

Both local Python 3.12.13 and 3.14.6 builds reproduced the shipped containers. The false rejections are controlled timestamp/compression/member variations, not a claim that those local versions naturally failed.

Validation:

- Five focused test groups pass on Python 3.12.13 and optimized Python 3.14.6: eight equivalent encodings, 24 changed/corrupt-payload CLI rejections, four positive CLI controls, source/anchor drift controls, and the exact three-line shell delta.
- The complete adapted PR589 bit replay passed all steps 0–8 in 131 seconds on macOS arm64 / Python 3.14.6, with NumPy 2.5.4, SymPy 1.14.0, SciPy 1.18.1 and Boost 1.87.0. It reproduced the original bit savings and checked 883/1,327/1,549 formal columns.
- The registered Python 3.12 package replay and selected-source baseline pass. No original repository file changed.

Reproduce the focused check:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit589-gzip-replay
```

Run the complete bit replay with the original native dependencies:

```sh
BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost_1_87_0 python3.14 -B research/bit589-gzip-replay/replay.py --work /fresh/external/bit589
```

The full run used normal generator compression; the alternate encodings were tested through both actual comparison sites in the focused harness. This is not a full selected `frontier1094` replay, new kappa, Lean proof, hosted-CI success, Windows validation or independent human review. The original theorem obligations remain inherited.

Task `portable-replay`, refined to these two generated words; base `55a02580ce1b283026e9d3b3510b218f8c93a4de`. The relevant roots are unchanged at subsequently checked main `c5108f0f68d482e5712a8e26a5978d47762dfc16`. `TASK.json`, `SOURCES.json` and `EVIDENCE.json` record scope, exact source pins, commands, environment and evidence. Discussion: #1547. Latest complete overlap snapshot covered 714 open PRs and 216 discussion records; this is bounded overlap evidence, not a novelty guarantee.

Credit DreamingOfClouds #589/#545, eumemic #555/#493 and the retained lineage; Maxime Fleury #220 / Antoine Olivier #214 for the payload convention; MrPink604 #819 for its earlier application to the distinct PR626 owner boundary. Pending #946/#1298 encoding fixes and #1509 Boost portability are complementary. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No merge or selected-frontier change requested.
